verdicts.reason: A shrinks the red 'LONGEST DAY SALE' banner to an illegible sliver tucked under the CTA, so the key offer badge is lost. Its headline also wraps with an orphaned 'last', and the legal line is moved up and styled almost like the subhead. B keeps the sale banner prominent at top-left, but the logo is pushed off-centre to the right and the headline has the same orphaned 'last'. B's CTA is oversized and crowded against the legal line, and its legal text is too large and sits right under the subhead.
